change: A window is not tested when more than 20 % of its bins lie in runs of 3 or more empty 0.1 s bins (gaps of 0.3 s or longer). Isolated empty bins are interpolated.
reason: The plot vertices come in top/bottom pairs (25 % of spacings under 0.013 s), so the column rate is about 7 per second and about 22 % of 0.1 s bins are empty everywhere. The original gate rejected 66-94 % of 10-30 s windows. Every Kadri candidate carries spec_gate_20pct (pass/fail under the original rule), so results exist with and without the change.

change: The shot period is found by a comb scan (2-60 s) of the onsets of the stronger half of bursts, then refined by the module's least-squares comb.
reason: Panel e: median onset difference of all bursts 3.3 s, ACF peak 10.0 s, because 78 secondary bursts sit between shots. The specification asks for a check but gives no rule for a disagreement. Result 9.93 s (panel d) and 9.96 s (panel e).

change: Where scipy's Gamma log survival function underflows, the asymptotic series of the upper incomplete gamma function is used.
reason: Numerical fault only: the first run floored the statistic at p = 1e-300 and 4-60 % of noise windows hit the floor. The statistic is unchanged.

change: The whitening spectrum is the median over the frames of the same 307 s record only.
reason: Same-hour background records were not blended in. The median over frames is robust to the transient itself.

change: N2 uses background days 1-14 March 2014 (1,344 records per logger held; 252-266 inside the clock hours).

Pre-registered rule applied: N3 failed (lag-1 ACF of quiet parts 0.01-0.05 in the Kadri record against 0.19 in the emulated open data), so N4 is the primary null at both Kadri stations. N3 p-values are reported as p_local_altnull.
reason: Not a deviation of the rule; recorded because it changes the calibration and because N4 proved anti-conservative for S2-S4 (see the run report).

change: Raw IMOS: 50 injections per (logger, shape, SNR, band) instead of 200 (135,000 in total). Kadri: 200 per cell on the 8 March off-window part at Cape Leeuwin; 100 per cell on N3 hosts. Diego Garcia South: N3 host only (no off-window part of the record). S7: 100 per SNR as specified. Network injections (B1, C1) and C2-C4 not run: outside this step.
reason: Compute time: 200 per cell would take about 3.6 h on 14 cores. Binomial standard error at a detection probability of 0.5 is about 7 % with 50.

change: Added: Royer 2016 spectrogram 5-40 Hz band series (S1-S4), with a null pooled over the off-window parts of all Royer panels of the same time resolution.
reason: Instruction to run on all data held. Colour scale saturates; marked in notes.

change: Where fewer than 60 s precede the window in its segment, the reference is the 300 s after the window (flag 'forward').
reason: 307 s records and 600 s panels make a 300 s causal reference impossible at segment starts.

change: S2 uses the S1 ring geometry (max(120 s, 6L) each side, guard max(10 s, L)).

Pseudo arrival windows of the same covered duration are drawn on a virtual timeline of the null segments (5,000 draws); the same draws serve every detector at a station for the across-method calibration. S8: 3 x the minimum p over the three widths.
reason: Equivalent to 'the same number of tests' when the duty cycle differs between records.

change: Overlapping windows of the same station, data form, detector, window length and band that pass local p of 0.05 or less are merged into one candidate (best window kept).
reason: Without merging, one transient gives up to 40 rows per setting.

change: Where Royer observed the arrival at the station, t_pred is the observed time and sigma is max(2 s, element spread). Antarctic blue whale Z-call detections (113 calls at OHASISBIO sites, station times, sigma 5 s) were added on the lead's instruction of 4 Nov 2026. Kadri 2024 Table 1, Kadri 2019 and CMST transients are labels only, as their catalogue treatment states.
reason: Inputs supplied after the specification; no detector changed.

change: W1 implementation: 2 s columns, Welch 0.5 s Hann segments (7 per column), Gamma likelihood, slope grid, path term with prior sd 1, weight = 2 x null percentile (1 = null median). W1_wide (primary, Pete Large, 4 Nov 2026, via the lead): flat to a free corner 0.5-20 Hz then slope 0-5, path term, free level, and bins that the smooth fit under-explains by more than 3x count against the shape. The F-35A-centred W1 (W1_metz) is reported beside it.
reason: Pete's steer: the F-35A comes from a much smaller aircraft. W1 changes rank only.

change: Source-class scores are rule-based. They were defined after the windows were opened and revised once (v2): tonality became the count of narrow bins under-explained by the smooth fit, and duration and rise were measured on the 1 s smoothed envelope. v1 measured spectral dynamic range, not tonality. Both versions are in the table. The spectral multiplier is clipped to 0.1-10.
reason: No removal changed between v1 and v2. The class factor cannot remove a candidate alone.

change: Co-located loggers (Perth Canyon 3315/3376, Portland 3274/3275) count as one site.
Measured vertex rate is about 19 per second (median spacing 0.049-0.052 s), not about 14.5-15.
reason: Observation; no parameter depends on it except D1.

change: Reduced W1 injection check: 30 per (logger, signal class, SNR) at 0, +6 and +12 dB, impact-like and tonal control.
reason: Compute time; it checks the direction of the weight only.
